item.title: How Lula’s Social Media Campaign Helped Him Win Brazil’s Election
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won another term on Sunday, with the help of a seismic social media campaign that convinced Brazilians to reject his rival.

item.title: Netanyahu Pushed for Attack on Iran Ahead of Israeli Election, Officials Say
item.description: Israel’s military chief resisted the prime minister, who then pressed in recent days for a separate action, short of an overt strike, according to an official and a person briefed on the matter.
